webhooks.detail: Outgoing webhooks (HTTP POST, JSON payload, optional JWS signature header) for 12 deploy events (started, succeeded, failed, deleted, locked, etc.); org-level webhooks also exist. Configured in UI; API-based hook creation not confirmed from these pages.

evidence.quote: This type of notification works as an outgoing webhook and allows you to send event information to an arbitrary URL using a POST request.

sandbox.detail: Free plan (300 credits/month, hard limit, never charged) usable to test integrations.

evidence.quote: You'll never be charged for the Free plan, so it's ideal for smaller experiments that don't need a lot of resources, security, or monitoring.

rate_limits.summary: 500 requests/min for most requests; deploys via API 3/min and 100/day

evidence.quote: For example, you can deploy through the Netlify API up to 3 times per minute and up to 100 times per day.
